title: The Natural Number Game, pinned fallback
objective: Reach induction practice by one of three routes, then choose the hypothesis a successor case needs and predict the goals that induction leaves.

segments.title: What the game is, and when it does not load

blocks.md:
The Natural Number Game is a disclosed, uncredited link-out. It runs its own Lean version, so a few tactics behave differently from the Bench, and your progress stays in the game: the course credits nothing done there. Lesson S2.L1 asks for four worlds: Tutorial, Addition, Multiplication and Implication.

Its host has not always answered, and a third-party page that failed to load cannot be detected from here, so this drawer is always linked beside the game and never inferred.

1. The community's in-browser port, at lean.cau.li/game, also a disclosed, uncredited link-out. It is a large download, and the card shows its size before anything loads {{run:RUN-lean-wasm}}.
2. The game from its repository at a pinned commit, built in the devcontainer (D-15). It brings its own Lean toolchain.
3. Original induction warm-ups in the lab template, on the course's own Lean {{run:RUN-lean-ledger}}: k deposits of 2, doubling, and one fee per step, from the bank in lesson S2.L1 {{run:RUN-lean-s2-cells}}.
The base case and the step. The hypothesis the step may use (D-05). And the habit of predicting each goal before you run a tactic (lesson S2.L3).

RUN-lean-ledger.title: Core Lean 4.35.0 proves the four ledger theorems, re-run with argv: conservation uses [propext, Quot.sound]
notes: <sandbox>/work in argv stands for a scratch copy of the files listed in inputs, mounted read-only.
Re-run by W0-S11 with argv, because RESULTS.md, the earlier record, holds no command line. The configurations named original hold that record.
Exit code 0 with no error line means every theorem in the file, the four ledger theorems among them, was accepted.

RUN-lean-wasm.title: The community WebAssembly build of Lean in Chromium: cross-origin isolated, its ready time, the version it reports and what a cold load downloads
notes: Re-run by W0-S11 from research/evidence/lean-measure/scripts/probe-wasm*.cjs (spine section 9.5). The earlier probe outputs (lean-measure/out/caul*.json) recorded ready times and the isolation flag but not the payload: probe-wasm2 appended "]}" to a complete net log and failed to parse it. The copy that ran tries the log as it is first; that is its only change.

The probes ran against the live site with Chromium from the pinned Playwright image (the earlier probes used a Chrome on the host). The net log itself and the screenshots are not committed; values.not_committed lists them with their hashes. netlog-summary.json sums the net log: bytes received on sockets, and body bytes per URL.
binary_sha256 is null because Chromium is a directory of files in the image; the image digest pins it.
The site is a third-party service whose content can change; this is a measurement of 2026-10-24, not a pin.
